blurb: Guests fish for striped bass, bluefish, groundfish, sharks, and tuna or enjoy lobster tours and scenic boat tours. Trips are private per boat with a maximum of 6 people on most tours. Captains are USCG licensed and experienced lifelong Maine fishermen.
extraNote: $100 deposit required at booking · All trips are private per boat, pricing per boat not per person · Tipping customary 15-20% if satisfied · Bluefin tuna over 73 inches become property of the boat; charterers receive up to 25% off charter cost after profits · Maximum 6 people on boat tours and sunset cruises · Trips may be cancelled or rescheduled due to weather (implied but not explicitly stated) · Dock at the parking lot at the end of Harbor Road, Wells, ME
